limitations: tv.cctv.com browser testing was blocked by the tool site-safety policy in the previous turn; no bypass was attempted. Yangshipin is a separately accessible official platform.
Yangshipin cold-load log included NotAllowedError for audible autoplay; subsequent selected channels were observed unmuted and playing after interaction.
Yangshipin includes a custom HLS/CMG/WASM player pipeline. Shared player code does not prove the sampled channel uses DRM.
Signed addresses were obtained from ordinary public official playback sessions. No signatures were generated, no DRM or paid access was bypassed.
Address reuse succeeded over the observed minutes; no exact expiration, overnight stability, new-IP reuse, fresh-profile or Windows behavior has been established.
Decode durations are media timestamp spans, not wall-clock listening durations. Startup timings are decoder/browser event timings on this network, not guaranteed product latency.
